description: The Aydın CLIMAAX project publishes geospatial inputs for river-flood risk assessment in western Türkiye. Zenodo supplies a dairy-farm location GeoJSON, the provincial boundary GeoPackage and a LUISA land-cover GeoTIFF free under CC BY 4.0. Together they locate food-production facilities and surrounding land cover within the assessment area. These layers can supply assets and context for flood-exposure and food-supply disruption simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this three-layer package. Coverage is Aydın Province and the source-layer vintages, which are not fully stated in the short description. Farm point positions are exposures, not evidence that buildings, livestock or supply chains would fail at a given water depth. Any upstream LUISA terms and positional uncertainty need checking before asset-level decisions. No file was downloaded or exposure intersection recomputed.
